lines_en: [Signal] NASDAQ (raw score 66%), S&P 500 (raw score 62%) | the model shows no out-of-sample discrimination: the 20-day probability of a gain is ~the base rate of 62% · experimental signal

lights.name: 趋势(MA200)
lights.note: 牛熊分界线，下方时一切看空信号加倍认真
lights.note_en: The bull/bear dividing line; below it, take every bearish signal twice as seriously.

lights.name: VIX期限结构
lights.note: 倒挂=恐慌（历史上倒挂后20日胜率64.8%，常近底部）
lights.note_en: Inversion = fear (historically the 20-day win rate after an inversion has been 64.8%, often close to a bottom).

lights.name: 收益率曲线(10Y-2Y)
lights.note: 倒挂(<0)是历史上最可靠的衰退预警，领先6-18个月
lights.note_en: An inversion (<0) is historically the most reliable recession warning, leading by 6-18 months.

lights.name: 信用利差(HY)
lights.note: 信用市场比股市先闻到危险；快速走阔=避险
lights.note_en: The credit market smells danger before equities do; a rapid widening means risk-off.
